independent_reference_source: MIMIC-IV-ECG Philips PageWriter Cardiograph Machine Measurements

heart_rate_bpm.algorithm: Pan-Tompkins QRS bandpass integration with median RR interval inversion

pr_interval_ms.algorithm: Isoelectric P-peak to QRS onset detection
pr_interval_ms.interpretation: Subject to P-wave amplitude variance; designated as heuristic prior to Module 4.

qrs_duration_ms.interpretation: Good bounding on wide QRS (>120ms); designated as heuristic estimator.

st_elevation.algorithm: J-point (+60ms) relative to PR isoelectric baseline
st_elevation.verification_rule: Requires >= 2 contiguous anatomical leads for acute MI confirmation

st_depression.algorithm: J-point (+60ms) relative to PR isoelectric baseline
st_depression.verification_rule: Measured across all active leads; strictly UNAVAILABLE if leads masked

t_wave_inversion.algorithm: ST-T segment (+200ms) negative excursion beyond -0.10 mV
t_wave_inversion.verification_rule: Measured strictly on unmasked precordial and limb channels
